release_notes: GoCardless token fix — API key no longer appears missing after update
changelog: FIXED: GoCardless API token no longer appears missing after update — credential lookup now falls back to the legacy SideKick_PS store when the SideKick_GC store has no token
FIXED: Payment plan payments now appear in the album after scheduling — ProSelect payment dialog is closed before the album reload (was failing with 'Application Busy')
Previous (v3.0.31): Updates and downloads restored — release channel moved to public SideKick_PS-Releases repo after source repo went private
Previous (v3.0.30): Phone E.164 normalisation fix; auto-detect country code from Windows locale
Previous (v3.0.30): GHL invoice creation no longer blocked for contacts without an email address
Previous (v3.0.30): Webhook now fires on --update-invoice path (re-syncs), not only on first-time syncs
Previous (v3.0.30): Order Webhook orderId guaranteed unique via invoice_id fallback
